about: Six NVIDIA claims of set C (eval/claim-tests-foreign-c.json, copied unchanged with their ids) for the example run with two model readers, docs/examples/v14/run-readers.json (make examples). The answers are read from eval/cassettes/claim-readers; set C's own recordings were made under the readers' prompt before rule 3 and no longer replay, so these six are recorded again under the current prompt with: make eval ARGS='claim-readers --set eval/claim-tests-example-readers.json --record --max-calls 12'. Chosen to show three readers agreeing (h005, h006), the two models reading a test the grammar refuses (h016, h022, h003) and every reader refusing (h001), as set C was read.
written_by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (the claims, in set C); chosen by the session that wrote the grammar

claims.text: Gross margin widened sequentially in each of the last two quarters.
The effective tax rate was higher in fiscal 2025 than in fiscal 2024.
Revenue growth in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 over the first was above 10% sequentially.
Over the three years to fiscal 2026 revenue compounded at more than 90% a year.
Data Center revenue grew by more than 60% in fiscal 2026, outpacing every other market platform.
